Tout est code

Apprendre Python pour penser clair, comprendre son époque et tout visualiser

Learn Python from zero, in French, written for Africa and its diaspora. Every example runs in the browser: press Run, change a number, run it again. Part one says why code is the language of the age of artificial intelligence. Part two lays the foundations, from variables to objects. Part three puts them to work to think, check misleading figures, draw charts and simulate. Part four builds three complete projects: a mental arithmetic game, a digital tontine, a school report with a market price dashboard.

William Foteping · 31 sections · 103,996 words · about 473 minutes
